subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

P + Q means ‘P is the mother of Q’,

P # Q means ‘P is the brother of Q’,

P & Q means ‘P is the sister of Q’,

and P % Q means ‘P is the father of Q’.

How is G related to S if ‘G & H % I & T # S’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d7d47b3e8886d3068f9e078980d48b9c4cc1943e89341c7d0c8c583d53ecdb6.png]

Given Expression: G & H % I & T # S

G & H → G is the sister of H. 

H % I → H is the father of I.

I & T → I is the sister of T. 

T # S → T is the brother of S. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bb1688b28c760a770fe7e9ac80572fa58aed3335f3a74c3cd1e8c33d32d4604.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ddba485347de4a4caccaa76eb39f6c5c07234688e0a3937fcd5018dd91cfa91.png] 

Thus, G is S's wife’s father's sister.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
